about: How a redirector rule's criterion value is read, by every reader: Prosper202\Rotator\Criterion (rtr.php, offrtr.php, the Redirectors page, Overview > Rotator Breakdown, the API's writes; tests/Rotator/CriterionTest.php) and go-cli's criterionValues/criterionMatchesEveryone/criterionNormalize (p202 rotator test, p202 diff; go-cli/cmd/rotator_criterion_test.go). Each case is a value as some writer stored it: values is what the redirects compare, everyone whether it matches every visitor, normalized what the writers store now.
